metadata.case_name: POON CHUN LAM v. YIP FUNG TEXTILES CO LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: supervisor at the Defendant’s textile factory

injuries.description: fracture of the first metatarsal of the Plaintiff’s left foot
source: X-ray revealed a fracture of the first metatarsal of the Plaintiff’s left foot, which Dr. Lam found to be consistent with the mechanism of injury described by the Plaintiff.
X-ray showed the previous fracture to have healed with no significant displacement.

manifestations.description: left foot pain during rainy days and with prolonged standing and walking
local tenderness and mild stiffness in the right big toe at the MTP joint
mild degree of residual pain and disability
mild reduction in work capacity so that he would probably need to take more short breaks during work

treatments_received.treatment: slab for immobilizing the left foot
source: The Plaintiff was treated with a slab for immobilizing the left foot and was issued with two crutches for walking.

treatments_received.treatment: issued with two crutches for walking
source: The Plaintiff was treated with a slab for immobilizing the left foot and was issued with two crutches for walking.
The slab was kept for about 2 months.

treatments_received.treatment: referred to and attended the orthopaedic clinic three times
source: The Plaintiff was referred to and attended the orthopaedic clinic three times.
There was no referral for physiotherapy as the Plaintiff opted for self exercise at home.

losses.description: mild degree of residual pain and disability

comparable_cases.case_name: Sin Fu Yan v. Cheung Kwok Leung & Ors.
Lee Sze Wai v. Law Chi Kin
Yip Yuen Neung Shirley v. Lee Sze Wai t/a 蝦碌美食
comparable_cases.injury_description: X-ray showed a fracture of the 4th metatarsal bone in the right foot. A short leg plaster was administered for 3 weeks while a course of physiotherapy was prescribed. Sick leave was granted up to 23 May 2008 when the Plaintiff was still having mild residual right ankle pain. Occasional intake of analgesic was necessary. She could no longer practise aerobics or step dance as she used to do and could not wear high heels.

comparable_cases.case_name: Singh Chamkaur v. Richard Ethan Latker t/a Sino-Indian Trade Enterprises
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture at the head of proximal phalanx of the left second toe; briefly received occupational therapy and then physiotherapy between August and September 2006. His condition had reportedly improved by 70 to 80% by September 2006.
